name: Activity Monitor
author: modib
description: A system activity monitor for the Omarchy bar: CPU and memory load side by side, temperature and fan RPM pinned to the right edge, and a popup panel with live history graphs plus Heaviest CPU, Heaviest Memory, and Idle Apps process lists.

barWidget.description: CPU, RAM, GPU, temperature, and fan load as sleek icon readouts, with a popup that ranks the heaviest CPU and memory consumers and surfaces idle apps you could reclaim. CPU temperature and fan RPM stay in the bar whenever a reading exists.

schema.label: Readout
schema.description: icons is sleek icon + figures + temperature; compact is glyph + gauge; full adds the temperature; labels spells the readout out as words. Right-clicking the widget cycles them.

schema.label: Item sequence
schema.description: Order of telemetry items in the bar, comma-separated: 'gpu,cpu,ram,cpu-temp,fan' with CPU and RAM adjacent and temperature/fan on the right.

schema.label: Show GPU load
schema.description: Show GPU load in the top bar (hidden automatically if no GPU card is found).

schema.label: Show CPU load
schema.description: Show CPU load percentage in the top bar.

schema.label: Show CPU temperature
schema.description: Show CPU temperature with thermometer icon.

schema.label: Show GPU temperature
schema.description: Show GPU temperature in the top bar.

schema.label: Show memory
schema.description: Show RAM / memory usage.

schema.label: Memory format
schema.description: 'used/total' (12/23G), 'used' (12.3G), 'percent' (52%), 'free' (11.1G), or 'available' (11.1G).

schema.label: Temperature format
schema.description: 'degree-unit' (45°C/113°F), 'degree' (45°), 'unit' (45C), 'unit-lower' (45c), or 'bare' (45).

schema.label: Use Fahrenheit (°F)
schema.description: Display temperatures in Fahrenheit (°F) instead of Celsius (°C).

schema.label: Percentage padding
schema.description: How percentages hold width: 'none' (natural flow), 'zero' (03%), 'lead' ( 3%), or 'trail'.

schema.label: Show vertical gauges
schema.description: Show vertical battery-style capsule gauges in the bar.

schema.label: Show figures with gauges
schema.description: Put numeric figures beside vertical gauges in compact and full modes.

schema.label: Icon size (px)
schema.description: 0 follows the theme's bar icon size.

schema.label: Show fan RPM
schema.description: Show the fan RPM figure and glyph in the top bar whenever a readable fan exists.

schema.label: GPU card preference
schema.description: 'auto' picks the active card; otherwise an index ('0', '1') or name substring.

schema.label: Monitors
schema.description: Which screens to draw on by connector name (e.g. 'DP-1,HDMI-A-1'). Empty means all screens.

schema.label: Left click runs
schema.description: Custom command to run on left click. Leave empty to open the built-in system telemetry panel.

schema.label: Process survey interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the popup re-runs its process survey behind the Heaviest CPU, Heaviest Memory, and Idle Apps lists. A short run out of one core while it samples.

schema.label: Rows per process list
schema.description: How many rows each of the Heaviest CPU, Heaviest Memory, and Idle Apps lists shows in the panel (3-5 recommended).

schema.label: CPU list floor (%)
schema.description: A process only appears in Heaviest CPU while it pulls more than this many percent of a core. Keeps the list short on quiet machines.

schema.label: Memory list floor (MiB)
schema.description: A process only appears in Heaviest Memory while its resident set stays above this many MiB. 0 chooses automatically: 10% of this machine's total RAM. Keeps the list short on quiet machines.
